script.code:
SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       i.item_batch_management,
       i.stock_control,
       CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR) AS based_uom,
       i.material_costing_method,
       CAST(i.purchase_unit_price AS CHAR) AS purchase_unit_price,
       COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
                  'alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR),
                  'base_qty', u.base_qty))
                   FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
                  WHERE u.Item_id = i.id
                    AND u.is_deleted = 0), '[]') AS uom_conversion_json
  FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.materialIdsCsv}}', ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (mid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
  JOIN item i
    ON i.id = sel.mid
   AND i.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS location_id,
       CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, b.organization_id,
       CAST(b.unrestricted_qty AS CHAR) AS unrestricted_qty,
       CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS reserved_qty,
       CAST(b.block_qty AS CHAR) AS block_qty,
       CAST(b.qualityinsp_qty AS CHAR) AS qualityinsp_qty,
       CAST(b.intransit_qty AS CHAR) AS intransit_qty,
       CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS balance_quantity
  FROM item_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND (b.material_id, b.location_id, b.plant_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.l, jt.p FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.balTuplesJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', l BIGINT PATH '$[1]', p BIGINT PATH '$[2]')) jt)

SELECT CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS location_id,
       CAST(b.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id, CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, b.organization_id,
       CAST(b.unrestricted_qty AS CHAR) AS unrestricted_qty,
       CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS reserved_qty,
       CAST(b.block_qty AS CHAR) AS block_qty,
       CAST(b.qualityinsp_qty AS CHAR) AS qualityinsp_qty,
       CAST(b.intransit_qty AS CHAR) AS intransit_qty,
       CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS balance_quantity,
       DATE_FORMAT(b.manufacturing_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS manufacturing_date,
       DATE_FORMAT(b.expired_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expired_date,
       b.remark, b.remark2, b.remark3
  FROM item_batch_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND (b.material_id, b.location_id, b.batch_id, b.plant_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.l, jt.b, jt.p FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.batchTuplesJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', l BIGINT PATH '$[1]', b BIGINT PATH '$[2]', p BIGINT PATH '$[3]')) jt)

SELECT CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(f.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(f.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       f.organization_id, CAST(COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0) AS CHAR) AS batch_id, f.fifo_sequence,
       CAST(f.fifo_cost_price AS CHAR) AS fifo_cost_price, CAST(f.fifo_initial_quantity AS CHAR) AS fifo_initial_quantity,
       CAST(f.fifo_available_quantity AS CHAR) AS fifo_available_quantity
  FROM fifo_costing_history f
 WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND f.is_deleted = 0
   AND (f.material_id, f.plant_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.p FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.costPairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', p BIGINT PATH '$[1]')) jt)
 ORDER BY f.id

SELECT CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN p.step_name LIKE 'IBA|RUN|%' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(p.step_name, 9) AS UNSIGNED) END) AS CHAR) AS latest_gen,
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN p.step_name LIKE 'IBA|RUN|%' THEN p.step_status END ORDER BY p.step_name DESC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS latest_status,
       CAST(SUM(p.step_name = 'IBA|DONE') AS CHAR) AS done,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step p
    ON p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p.job_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.operationKey}}'
   AND p.step_name LIKE 'IBA|%'
   AND p.is_deleted = 0
 GROUP BY n.t

script.code:
SELECT CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS location_id,
       CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, b.organization_id,
       CAST(b.unrestricted_qty AS CHAR) AS unrestricted_qty,
       CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS reserved_qty,
       CAST(b.block_qty AS CHAR) AS block_qty,
       CAST(b.qualityinsp_qty AS CHAR) AS qualityinsp_qty,
       CAST(b.intransit_qty AS CHAR) AS intransit_qty,
       CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS balance_quantity
  FROM item_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND (b.material_id, b.location_id, b.plant_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.l, jt.p FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.balTuplesJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', l BIGINT PATH '$[1]', p BIGINT PATH '$[2]')) jt)

SELECT CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS location_id,
       CAST(b.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id, CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, b.organization_id,
       CAST(b.unrestricted_qty AS CHAR) AS unrestricted_qty,
       CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS reserved_qty,
       CAST(b.block_qty AS CHAR) AS block_qty,
       CAST(b.qualityinsp_qty AS CHAR) AS qualityinsp_qty,
       CAST(b.intransit_qty AS CHAR) AS intransit_qty,
       CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS balance_quantity,
       DATE_FORMAT(b.manufacturing_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS manufacturing_date,
       DATE_FORMAT(b.expired_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expired_date,
       b.remark, b.remark2, b.remark3
  FROM item_batch_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND (b.material_id, b.location_id, b.batch_id, b.plant_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.l, jt.b, jt.p FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.batchTuplesJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', l BIGINT PATH '$[1]', b BIGINT PATH '$[2]', p BIGINT PATH '$[3]')) jt)

SELECT CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(f.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(f.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       f.organization_id, CAST(COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0) AS CHAR) AS batch_id, f.fifo_sequence,
       CAST(f.fifo_cost_price AS CHAR) AS fifo_cost_price, CAST(f.fifo_initial_quantity AS CHAR) AS fifo_initial_quantity,
       CAST(f.fifo_available_quantity AS CHAR) AS fifo_available_quantity
  FROM fifo_costing_history f
 WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND f.is_deleted = 0
   AND (f.material_id, f.plant_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.p FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.costPairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', p BIGINT PATH '$[1]')) jt)
 ORDER BY f.id

SELECT CAST(w.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(w.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, w.plant_id, w.organization_id,
       CAST(COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0) AS CHAR) AS batch_id, CAST(w.wa_quantity AS CHAR) AS wa_quantity,
       CAST(w.wa_cost_price AS CHAR) AS wa_cost_price, w.created_at
  FROM wa_costing_method w
 WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND w.is_deleted = 0
   AND (w.material_id, w.plant_id) IN (SELECT jt.m, jt.p FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.costPairsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', p BIGINT PATH '$[1]')) jt)
 ORDER BY w.id

SELECT m.operation_effect_key
  FROM inventory_movement m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND m.operation_effect_key IN (SELECT jt.k FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_IBguard.data.effectKeysJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (k VARCHAR(255) CHARSET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci PATH '$')) jt)
   AND m.is_deleted = 0
